name: ds-superbot
description: Work-item console for DeepSeek Harness: the work item is the only product object, group chat is the main human/AI console, and the four presence faces (cang / tan / zuo / yan) cover sense, explore, build and verify. Decisions stay with humans, operations with AI, judgment with programs. The 0.1.0 seven-role superbot_dispatch path is kept as compatibility implementation, not the product cover.
author: Lin
